The certified results give every contest's write-in votes as one line, precinct by precinct. The Board's write-in report names the write-in candidates who filed and gives each one's count for the whole district only (some as '1+'), so its findings are in the contests' notes and not stored as figures.
Wards as the Board's files give them

The Board's files give each precinct one ward, and a ward's figures here are its precincts added up. The ward lines drawn for 2022 cut through some precincts, so a ward contest can reach precincts given as in another ward, or be on only some of a precinct's ballots: WARD SIX MEMBER OF THE COUNCIL OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA (precincts 18, 21, 81, 86, 87, 91, 131, 143); WARD SIX MEMBER OF THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION DISTRICT (precincts 18, 21, 81, 86, 87, 91, 131, 143). A ward's added-up figures can therefore hold votes cast in a neighbouring ward's contest; each such contest's note names the precincts.
